titre: Can your king catch both pawns? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Réti's famous study (1921): the white king looks hopelessly far from both pawns. Walking diagonally, it chases the black pawn and supports its own pawn at the same time. Draw! Would you have found Kg7? 👇
